privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: NERV practices transfer and situation gaps
goal: Every NERV procedure, audit and check is mapped to the template, other repositories, the solution or NERV only; what NERV and the solution lack for their situation is ranked with evidence
acceptance: docs/reviews/2026-11-26-nerv-practices-transfer.md inventories NERV's practices beyond the template with file:line evidence and classifies each as template (A), specific projects (B), solution (C) or NERV only (D), marking items already planned (harness F-102 to F-105, coordinator F-016 to F-018) instead of proposing them again

it lists what NERV lacks that other repositories have, the common practices missing across the nine, and a 'Situation-based gaps (NERV)' section ranked by likelihood and impact, with the same lens for the solution
the proposals are numbered for the owner; nothing is changed in a component

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from F-017-T06 (a read-only sweep of the same nine repositories) plus the owner's widened situation review. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-26 at the owner's request; verification is the PR's green CI.
